newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures settle at lows in correction.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures settle at lows in correction.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures gave up gains made Monday and closed barely above the day's lows, a bearish near-term signal, floor sources said.
They said early trade selling pressured prices lower and into speculative stops, which accelerated losses.
The spot-November contract finished at 110.05, off 5.10, having ranged from 115.25 to 110.00. The back months settled 2.40 to 1.30 lower.
"This was a correction to an overbought market," said Kevin Marshburn, an analyst with Fimat Futures.
He said the November contract would likely trade in a range between 106.00 and 116.00 ahead of the U.S. Department of Agriculture's estimate for the Florida crop, released October 11.
The last trading day for November FCOJ options is Friday.
